_doc: c26 actor: per-re-bow level shapes fitted on the first c26 render (stems in /private/tmp/claude-501/mockup-loop/c26-actor/render1). Per track, re-bows in order: 50 ms RMS every 20 ms, smoothed 0.12 s (L). Window k = [0, 1.5 s] after re-bow k: dB = ref - L, where ref runs linearly from the pre level (mean -0.45..-0.1 s, with the previous hold added) by the c25 render's own 3 s-mean level change over the same span (the morendo as c25 played it, before re-bows); after the window the dB holds at target - post (post = mean 1.3..1.5 s) until the next re-bow, and after the last one to the release. Clamped -6..+9 dB. Points [seconds after the re-bow's score onset, dB]; the first point of each list starts at the previous hold. v600 port (c27): kept; the final chord's held notes under every point are unchanged (Violas: the added A flat 3 plays on Violas div). fitted by tools/fit_rebows.py on cycle 27 (see its docstring). c29: Violins II 45/51 and Double basses 221.8-235.659 and 276.05-283.605 refitted on the c28 stems with the stale loop profiles taken out (stem_fix simulation, fit_rebows.py --stems), Double basses 273.229 skipped (the p-to-ppp decrescendo sat in its reference window; c28's fit lifted the ppp pedal to the p level), the stale keys Violins II 44.341/50.352 and Double basses 222.452 deleted. c32 (critic A #5, S1): Violins II 45 (the new slur's same-pitch tenuto) -3 dB from -0.12 to +0.08 s and 0 from +0.12 to +0.36 s, so the re-articulation is not filled. c34: Violoncellos div (all) and the Double basses pedals 221.8-235.659 and 276.05-283.605 refitted by fit_rebows.py on cycle 33 (basses with --window 2.6, 273.229 skipped); other keys kept. Basses pedal fits re-levelled so each piece keeps its c29-c33 mean (the 2.6 s fit chained the pieces +2..+6 dB up); Violins II 223 -4 dB over -0.04..1.48 s (C #2). fitted by tools/fit_rebows.py on cycle 40 (see its docstring). fitted by tools/fit_rebows.py on cycle 41 (see its docstring). c42: 223 (Violins II, Violas, Violoncellos) and Violins II 263.921 refit on c41 with the CC7 lane in the plan; Violas 296.9 held at -3.0 from 1.12 s; Violas div 298.3 / 301.25 back to c39 (bar 91 morendo, A #4 / C #4). fitted by tools/fit_rebows.py on cycle 42 (see its docstring). c52 (critics A #4, B #1): residual corrections on the c51 stems for the re-bows whose previous piece changed length with the c51 tempo map (cycles/c52/actor_scripts/resid52.py): Violoncellos div:275.527, Violoncellos div:277.599, Violoncellos div:284.141:2.5, Double basses:225.215:1.2, Double basses:233.038, Double basses:235.659, Violoncellos:293.6. c52 (critics A #4, B #1): residual corrections on the c51 stems for the re-bows whose previous piece changed length with the c51 tempo map (cycles/c52/actor_scripts/resid52.py): Double basses:225.215, Double basses:227.775.
